purpose: Validate exact named-plate sparse pixel transport and a new direct-stamp morphology feature contract on the frozen 64-source blind pilot, before scaling those measurements to the full 122,820-row S0 cohort. The direct-stamp features are explicitly not renamed versions of SExtractor/PSFEx quantities.

frozen_sample.selection_rule: For each frozen structural cluster 0..15: two closest to cluster-median anomaly score plus two highest anomaly score, src_id tie-break.
frozen_sample.reason: The sample was selected before any pixel morphology outcome and spans all 16 blind structural strata.

pixel_transport_contract.source_plate: Exact frozen named POSS-I plate_id from C0M; never use a generic sky cutout that may silently choose another plate.
pixel_transport_contract.source_center: Frozen fullplate_x0/fullplate_y0 from the admitted header-only acquisition map.
pixel_transport_contract.indexing: Round the frozen floating center to the nearest integer pixel only for array slicing. Preserve the subpixel center offset for feature calculations.
pixel_transport_contract.remote_access: Read only the 81x81 hdu.section corresponding to the exact named plate and source center using fsspec/HTTP range access.
pixel_transport_contract.edge_behavior: If a full 81x81 stamp cannot be read at the frozen coordinate, record STAMP_EDGE_OR_TRANSPORT_FAILURE; do not shift the window.

direct_feature_contract.photographic_polarity: Use inverted intensity I = 65535 - raw_pixel so point-source density becomes positive signal, matching the upstream experimental shape stage polarity.
direct_feature_contract.background: Estimate median and robust sigma = 1.4826*MAD from pixels at radius 18 <= r <= 38 pixels around the frozen subpixel center. No source-dependent background retuning.

features.name: stamp_peak_snr
features.formula: (maximum inverted intensity within r<=5 - background_median) / robust_background_sigma

features.name: stamp_concentration_r2_r5
features.formula: signal flux within r<=2 divided by signal flux within r<=5

features.name: stamp_concentration_r3_r7
features.formula: signal flux within r<=3 divided by signal flux within r<=7

features.name: stamp_moment_centroid_dx_px,stamp_moment_centroid_dy_px
features.formula: positive-signal weighted centroid within r<=10 relative to the frozen subpixel center; diagnostic only, never used to recenter the stamp or recompute other features

features.name: stamp_moment_fwhm_proxy_px
features.formula: 2.354820045 * sqrt((lambda_major + lambda_minor)/2), where eigenvalues are the second central moment covariance eigenvalues of positive signal within r<=10 around its diagnostic weighted centroid

features.name: stamp_moment_ellipticity
features.formula: 1 - sqrt(lambda_minor/lambda_major), clipped only for numerical roundoff to [0,1]

features.name: stamp_circularity,stamp_contour_area,stamp_shape_defect,stamp_circle_deviation
features.formula: Same repaired OpenCV contour formulas used in admitted B3S, applied to the 21x21 cutout centered on the frozen predicted source position; thresholds 21 and 45; convexityDefects normalized to (-1,4) without changing /256 depth scaling.

features.name: stamp_outer_laplacian_mad
features.formula: MAD of 3x3 discrete Laplacian of inverted image on the outer annulus 18<=r<=38; intended as local photographic texture/defect-density proxy.

features.name: stamp_outer_5mad_outlier_fraction
features.formula: Fraction of outer-annulus inverted pixels whose absolute deviation from outer median exceeds 5 * robust_background_sigma.

explicit_non_equivalences.stamp_moment_fwhm_proxy_px: NOT SExtractor FWHM_IMAGE and must never be renamed as such.
explicit_non_equivalences.stamp_moment_ellipticity: NOT SExtractor ELLIPTICITY/ELONGATION and must never be renamed as such.
explicit_non_equivalences.profile_diff: NOT measured by the 81x81 direct-stamp path because upstream profile_diff requires an 8-arcmin flux-matched comparison-star neighborhood. Preserve B3S profile_diff only as a pilot/upstream quantity; do not fabricate a direct-stamp equivalent.
explicit_non_equivalences.local_defect_density: Outer texture metrics are proxies and require later plate/control calibration before physical interpretation.

predeclared_C1A_gates.transport: 64/64 frozen sources must return an exact 81x81 stamp from their frozen named plate without full-array access or plate substitution.
predeclared_C1A_gates.central_signal: At least 95% of sources must have finite stamp_peak_snr >= 5.0. Report all failures; do not change polarity, annulus or threshold after viewing the result.
predeclared_C1A_gates.diagnostic_centroid: At least 95% of sources must have diagnostic positive-signal centroid offset <= 4.0 pixels from the frozen center, and 100% must be <= 8.0 pixels. The diagnostic centroid is never fed back into feature extraction.
predeclared_C1A_gates.moment_feature_coverage: At least 95% must have finite stamp_moment_fwhm_proxy_px and stamp_moment_ellipticity.
predeclared_C1A_gates.contour_feature_coverage: At least 90% must have finite stamp_circularity and stamp_circle_deviation. shape_defect coverage is reported separately because convex contours can legitimately have no finite defect depth.
predeclared_C1A_gates.outer_texture_coverage: 64/64 must have finite outer-annulus background sigma, stamp_outer_laplacian_mad and stamp_outer_5mad_outlier_fraction.
predeclared_C1A_gates.no_retrofit: No feature formula, stamp size, annulus, central radius, polarity or gate threshold may be changed after C1A outcome. Any repair must become a separately preregistered C1B-style corrective experiment.

report_only_crosschecks_against_B3S: Spearman correlation of stamp_moment_fwhm_proxy_px vs pass2 FWHM_IMAGE
Spearman correlation of stamp_moment_ellipticity vs pass2 ELONGATION
absolute/robust differences between sparse-stamp contour metrics and B3S contour metrics
feature distributions split by frozen structural_cluster and sample_role
crosscheck_rule: The B3S comparisons are report-only in C1A because the direct moment estimators are intentionally different algorithms. They may motivate a future preregistered calibration but cannot be used to tune C1A formulas or declare PASS/FAIL.

forbidden_inputs: Blue Book or other human-report labels
